answers.note: This feels so much more like a brand identity than just throwing Aurora everywhere. However, an additional exploration to polish would be huge. I can tell some creativity was distilled across so many ideas on how to infuse the vision. The other options were also pretty cool (Contact Sheet and Everyone's Color) and could be checked to see if those explorations offered any additional ideas for Afterglow enhancement. No worries if Afterglow wants to take its totally own creative direction. As a final note, remember this should feel polished, not like a junior designer was told to build a rainbow app. We are world-class tastemakers.
